limitations: USA only, historical S&P500 intervals not world market-cap universe
Top100 by lagged trailing dollar volume, not issuer market cap
Market-only residual; dated sector classifications unavailable, no genuine sector weight caps
USD nominal account, no historical EUR conversion; zero cash yield
Adjusted total return units, tax on simulated gains with historical engine tax proxy, no separate dividend withholding
Nominal $50m daily liquidity filter preserved; weak coverage/exposure before the modern era
Execution at observed next-session opening or next-session closing when actual open unavailable
No unobserved fills; original simulator can mark missing holdings at zero after 5 bars and may retain locked slots; delisting proceeds not separately modeled
Exploratory 40% coverage is incomplete and can have severe selection bias
Not exact Atlas replay; no parameter tuning
